description: One if-so payment in plain words, from the same chain read as ifso_get_payment: what it waits for, the deadline, who can do what next (claim, accept, tap OK, decide, settle, send back, cancel) and when and where it comes back if nothing happens. Payment ids are large whole numbers; pass them as a string.

id.description: The payment id as a decimal string, e.g. "12" or a 78-digit id.

name: ifso_explain_payment
title: Explain an IFSO payment
